title: Hinomori Shizuku — Keeping You From Falling〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, this seems like a good place to wrap up our morning practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line:
Nice work...
Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Good morning.
Uh, Shizuku, Airi, are you both free to talk right now by chance?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we can talk. We just wrapped up our morning practice!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
Ms. Kawasaki asked me to deliver a present.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ms. Kawasaki...?
Isn't she the person who asked you guys to be models?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, she's a professional photographer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She actually stopped by the cafe An's dad runs to tell us that she received an award for her entry.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And gave us some photos to mark the occasion...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, from during the shoot?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! I wanna see! I wanna see!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're looking at the camera for some of these, but not all of them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And you all have such wonderful smiles on your faces...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, this was when one of An's heels slipped off as we were moving between scenes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku picked it up and even helped her put it back on. Oh, here it is! This is a photo of that moment!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! She's like a prince...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, my heart raced when I saw that too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? All I did was help her a little since it seemed very difficult to crouch while wearing that dress...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I think trying to copy Len helped as well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Miku, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I'm wearing these new shoes because they go with my outfit, but they slip off so easily...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Where'd my shoe go...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here it is, Miku.
Mind sticking your foot out for me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, I can put it back on myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (From time to time, we get to see these wonderful displays of chivalry in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'll be sure to tell them about what I did the next time I get a chance to visit.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, did you tell Shiho about us doing some modeling?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. She was there when I told my mom and everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but I mostly talked about working with Kohane and the others. I didn't really get a chance to talk about me wearing a tuxedo.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. If that's the case, I'm sure they'll be very surprised when they see these photos.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'll tell them all about what happened after I return home today.
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright...
What do you want to show me so much that you had to call me over?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how I said I'd be doing some work that involves wearing a wedding dress?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The photographer was nice enough to give us some photos of the shoot to mark the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I wanted to show them to you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what this is about...?
Okay, if we're just looking at a few photos...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really?! In that case, let's start going through them! There were four of us there and this one shows us all together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?! Shizuku, you wore a tux?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I did! And I was just as surprised since I was under the impression that I'd be wearing a dress.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So... How do I look?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It actually suits you pretty well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd seen some of your other modeling photos before, but never anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's really nice.
Not only does it suit you, but it's also a fresh perspective.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey! W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe! I couldn't be happier, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
The photos are gonna get all crumpled!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It'll be fine♪ I'm being careful.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You say that, but...
If you're gonna be this clingy, I'm heading back to my room.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
B-But!
There are still so many photos that I want to look at with you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then promise not to literally be all over me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise.
